environment.description: Same FastAPI service deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) with Pod Security Admission enforcing 'restricted' profile. Container securityContext specifies drop: [ALL] with add: [NET_BIND_SERVICE] only. The pod runs behind an Istio service mesh sidecar (envoy 1.29) configured with outlier detection (consecutive5xxLimit: 3, interval: 10s) and a retry policy with exponential backoff (baseInterval: 25ms, maxInterval: 250ms). Node-level tc (traffic control) netem qdisc adds 2ms ± 1.5ms jitter on the pod veth interface via a DaemonSet init container. Additionally, the Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts ingress to the service only from the istio-ingressgateway namespace, and the istio VirtualService has a 50 req/s rate limit per source IP with local rate limiting via EnvoyFilter.

config.network_jitter: tc qdisc netem delay 2ms 1.5ms distribution normal on pod veth
config.rate_limit: 50 req/s per source IP via EnvoyFilter local_rate_limit
